source_record.title: Senior Partner
source_record.description:
About the Role

Join an AI-native legal services startup as a senior partner and help shape its growth. You will bring an established, portable client practice to the firm while helping move recurring legal work into AI-supported workflows.

What You'll Do

  • Develop the firm's growth through your professional network and established client relationships.

  • Continue advising your clients while transitioning suitable work into the firm's technology platform.

  • Build cross-selling opportunities for commercial and compliance services across your client base.

  • Represent the firm in the market and work with the founding team to improve legal service delivery through automation.

What We're Looking For

  • 12 or more years of German legal practice, with partner-level experience at a recognized law firm or boutique.

  • A portable, diversified book of business worth at least €1 million, ideally with connections to private equity, venture capital, or mid-market businesses.

  • Experience in recurring, automatable areas such as commercial contracts, IT and data, corporate and venture capital, or regulatory work.

  • German-qualified Volljurist admitted as a Rechtsanwalt, with native-level German and professional English.

  • Hands-on experience with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or legal AI software, and an interest in applying automation to legal work.

  • Germany-based and authorized to work in Germany, with a feasible path to transition client work.

Compensation & Benefits

Annual compensation is €200,000 to €300,000, with meaningful equity participation. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Location

Hybrid, based in Berlin, Germany.
